Tailor made solutions

No matter how big or small your requirement is, your logistics partner cannot satisfy your needs if its team, does not combine passion with expertise.

Each member of our team knows this well, that to be the essential part of our group, and through expertise. commitment, creativity, passion, and dedication, our team is able to deliver tailor-made solutions to our customers. from a small sample shipment to a large scale movement or supply chain management project.

At CTO, your satisfaction is our passion!

Although our offices are capable of handling any type of goods, it is important to
emphasize our great expertise in some specific vertical markets:

Trade Shows & Global Events

As a global logistics provider that specializes in organizing global events all over the world, we understand how important is the value of your business and we guarantee that everything runs safely and delivered on time.

Learn more
Aerospace

Over the years, CTO Group got significantly involved in the Aerospace supply chain, streamlining the flow of parts. developing relationships with component vendors, and providing comprehensive AOG services.

Learn more
Pharma

The Pharmaceutical market is continuously growing and changing, new products available and research for the shortest transit time. CTO Group has dedicated personnel and special agreements to allow always the best available level of service.

Learn more
Luxury & Fashion

CTO Group has a great experience in Fashion and Luxury business. Since our beginning we have been handling the most important labels worldwide, both in retail and wholesale.

Learn more
Aid & Relief

We offer experience in delivering humanitarian and commercial aid projects to remote locations around the globe in a timely and efficient manner when time is of the essence. When time is vital and you need to ensure the job gets done right the first time.

Learn more
Chemicals

The chemical industry has been growing consistently and our group is well suited to provide the best tools to successfully support our clients.

Learn more
Automotives

One of the most challenging markets is the Automotive. Just in time deliveries and industrial planning are one of the core business of CTO Group. We are specialized in this offering dedicated pick-ups and deliveres both for spare parts.

Learn more
Food & Perishables

Our goal is to be your preferred global supplier of perishables logistics to guarantee an experience where your products are always monitored and taken care always respecting the cool chain procedures.

Learn more
People come first

People are the essential part of CTO project and the greatest driver of our change who work at the cutting-edge of research of solutions to our clients.

And our group is the playing-ground where our people, with great professionalism and commitment combined with creativity, dedication and passion for their work, experience every day new ethical values of responsibility. sharing and cooperation between human beings.

We transform ourselves to transform the entire world!
